taskDescription:
Prepare Skillrunner for v0.1.0 open-source beta launch with Homebrew integration.

The project is a Go-based local-first AI workflow orchestration tool. We need to:
1. Fix critical code issues (OpenCode backend stub, terminal spawner, chat provider registration, git branch check)
2. Integrate API key encryption properly
3. Add release infrastructure (goreleaser, GitHub Actions release workflow)
4. Create missing documentation (LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, CHANGELOG.md)
5. Update CI to Go 1.24 and add release automation
6. Integrate with homebrew tap at https://github.com/jbctechsolutions/homebrew-skillrunner
7. Update version from 0.1.0-dev to 0.1.0 with proper ldflags injection

features.description: Add MIT LICENSE file to root directory
Create CHANGELOG.md with initial release notes for v0.1.0
Add GitHub issue and PR templates (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)
Create .goreleaser.yaml for multi-platform binary releases with ldflags version injection
Create GitHub Actions release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) triggered on version tags
Update CI workflow to Go 1.24 and add security scanning
Fix OpenCode backend - implement basic functionality or mark as experimental with proper error messages
Fix terminal spawner in workspace command to actually spawn terminal
Fix chat command provider registration to properly wire providers
Fix git branch existence check in workspace manager
Integrate API key encryption into provider initialization flow
Update Makefile with release targets and ldflags documentation
Create Homebrew formula update script that generates SHA256 and updates homebrew-skillrunner repo
